information:
Esta competição será no **mesmo espaço e no mesmo dia do FMC Europa 2024**.Se queres registar-te para o FMC Europa, podes fazê-lo na página de competição do [FMC Europa](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCEurope2024).

Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50870-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50862-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 10%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50869-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
This competition will be on the **same day and venue as FMC Europe**. If you want to register for FMC Europe, you will be able to register following the steps in the [FMC Europe 2024](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCEurope2024) competition page.
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50870-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50862-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 10% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindinAveiro2024#50869-associados-aps-aps-associates).
